node.title: Re: launching external process macOS
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
On Windows I usually launch external processes from the Shell using "system". ... Which is the best way to achieve the same in a script for macOS?

In theory it should be exactly the same (except for the .exe extension of course), [doc://system] is cross-platform (with a few caveats, see [doc://perlport#system|system in perlport]). Have you tried it, are you having any problems? If so, please post the exact error message along with a short piece of code needed to reproduce the error (an [id://1177642|SSCCE]).

BTW, you should check the return value of [doc://system] for errors; it is also reflected in [doc://$?] (but only rely on its value immediately after the call). I wrote at length about the topic of running external commands [id://1180578|here].
